components.description: Envoy-based reverse proxy for the various user-facing web interfaces.
Next.js webstore with a client-side application and an API layer exposing REST endpoints to backend services.
Locust-based generator that creates simulated HTTP and headless-browser traffic against the frontend.
Provides advertisements based on context keys, or random ads when none are given.
Stores and retrieves user shopping carts using Valkey.
In-memory key-value store holding user shopping carts.
Provides checkout services for the application and publishes new orders to Kafka.
C++ service that converts amounts from one currency to another.
Sends the customer an order confirmation email by rendering it as a log message.
Processes and validates payments for the application.
Rust service that gets price quotes from quote, provides tracking IDs, and simulates fulfillment and shipping.
PHP service that calculates shipping costs based on the number of items.
Go gRPC service serving the product catalog backed by PostgreSQL.
Relational database queried by the product catalog service.
Spring Boot service recommending other products based on the currently selected product.
KRaft-mode message queue connecting checkout with the accounting and fraud detection services.
.NET service that consumes new orders from a Kafka topic.
Service that receives new orders from a Kafka topic and flags suspected fraud cases.
Feature flag service that services query for flag values such as intlShippingSlowdown.
